whatWasAttempted: Run the ORIGIN turn through the real first-party DSH Host under the test-owned deterministic adapter, so the origin has a REAL DSH Session (achieved: the session id was captured from the host OWN IPC identity report and the product DSH reader read 18 real events from it).
Have that origin Result genuinely admitted by Work settlement so A0 is a real first-party origin.
whatWasEstablished: The origin DSH Session IS genuinely first-party: the identity was observed on the child IPC channel and the session was persisted under the test-owned root.
The product Capsule for A1 read the ORIGIN REAL session through the product OWN reader (capsuleReadOriginSession matches originDshSessionId).
whatWasNotEstablished: A genuine canonical Origin Result. The deterministic adapter reports READY_FOR_SETTLEMENT but performs no Git modification, so settleMutatingWork would observe an unchanged world. §9.5 forbids fabricating a settlement or forging a Result to merge the rigs.
whyNotPursued: Making the deterministic adapter perform real, allowed Git work and commit it through legitimate tooling is a MATERIAL change to the adapter beyond this stage slice; §9.5 explicitly permits recording E0-L2 as NOT_ESTABLISHED instead of weakening Work authority.
conclusion: E0-L2 (real first-party ORIGIN chain) is NOT_ESTABLISHED. The origin SESSION is real first-party DSH; the origin RESULT is not genuinely admitted.
remainingUncertainty: A future stage could extend the deterministic adapter to perform a real allowed Git modification, which would let the origin Result be genuinely settled and would qualify E0-L2.
